title: Elementwise interpolation between a carried vector and a fresh candidate
summary: A carried vector is updated at each symbol by mixing it, coordinate by coordinate, with a fresh candidate computed from the symbol alone. The mixing weights are a squashed linear function of the symbol, so the symbol decides how much of each coordinate is kept. There is no dependence of the mixing on the carried vector.
core_idea: Carry a vector that is mixed per coordinate with a symbol-only candidate under symbol-dependent retention weights, giving an input-dependent diagonal linear recurrence.

state.name: h
state.meaning: Carried vector; each coordinate is a running mixture of earlier candidates with symbol-dependent retention.

update.name: retention
update.latex: f_t = \sigma(W_f x_t + b_f),\; u_t = W_u x_t
update.plain: retention weights f_t = sigmoid(W_f x_t + b_f) in (0,1)^d and candidate u_t = W_u x_t, both from the symbol embedding x_t = E[s_t] only

update.name: mix
update.plain: h_t = f_t * h_(t-1) + (1 - f_t) * u_t, elementwise

readout.name: symbol
readout.plain: next symbol scores O y_t over the V symbols

learning.description: Every matrix and offset is learned by gradient descent on the cross-entropy of the next symbol over a training corpus, with backpropagation through the whole sequence. Because the mixing does not read h, training can run all positions in parallel with a prefix scan.
learning.few_shot_argument: No structure for few examples; about 5000 training sequences are needed for copying at L = 4.

complexity.constants_notes: Two d by d input projections, d elementwise mixes and the output map per symbol; the carried state is d numbers.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Gradient descent with no structure for few examples.

prediction.statement: From random weights, 5000 copy examples at L = 4 over 4 symbols give per-string accuracy 0.99.

capabilities.task: copy a string after a separator
capabilities.prediction: Exact with hand-set weights only when L log2 D is below the bits of the d carried numbers.
Not solvable at any length above 2 with this mixing alone, because each coordinate is a monotone combination of candidates.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: A hand-set configuration computes the parity of 8-bit strings exactly.
The counted operations grow faster than linearly in n at fixed d and V.
